# MarketLens

> World of Warcraft auction-house market screener and observed-population survey.
> Realm market and population data are uploaded by the MarketLens in-game addon.
> Base URL: https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev

The human-facing pages (/ and /item/...) fill their tables client-side from the
JSON API below, so fetching that HTML without running JavaScript returns only a
placeholder. Fetch the JSON endpoints directly instead — they are the source of
truth and are edge-cached.

## Conventions

- `<game>` is a dataset key: an uploaded realm, `realm:<RealmName>` or
  `realm:<RealmName>-<Faction>`, e.g. `realm:Ashkandi-Alliance`. Call /api/games
  for the live list. Any other key returns an empty dataset.
- Money values (mv, asp) are in copper. 100 copper = 1 silver; 10000 copper = 1
  gold.

## API

- [/api/games](https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev/api/games): Every dataset
  present, each with `game`, `label`, `count`, `updatedAt`, `realm`, `hasItems`,
  `hasPop`, `sourceGame`.
- [/api/items?game=<game>](https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev/api/items?game=realm:Ashkandi-Alliance):
  Latest market snapshot for a realm. Returns `game`, `sourceGame`, `region`,
  `count`, `updatedAt`, `days`, `columns`, and `items`. `items` is an array of
  arrays; `columns` names each position. Current order:
  `["id","name","slug","mv","asp","q","pq","sc","tc","cat","src","crafter"]`
  where mv=listed value (q x asp), asp=realm buyout (weighted median unit
  price), q=quantity listed in the latest scan, pq=quantity in the scan before it
  (null when there is none; "% change since last scan" is (q-pq)/pq),
  sc=distinct sellers, tc=top-seller concentration (0-100, the largest single
  seller's share of listed quantity), cat=category, src=supply source,
  crafter=producing profession.
- [/api/history?game=<game>&id=<itemId>](https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev/api/history?game=realm:Ashkandi-Alliance&id=2589):
  Daily time series for one item. Returns `points`, an array of objects with
  `ts` (YYYYMMDD integer), `mv`, `asp`, `q`.
- [/api/population?game=realm:<realm>](https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev/api/population?game=realm:Ashkandi-Alliance):
  Observed population survey sampled via in-game /who. Returns `realm`,
  `faction`, `samples`, `sightings`, `perDayUnique`, `updatedAt`, `classes`
  (token -> count), `races` (token -> count), `demand` (inferred profession
  demand: array of `{prof, weight, score}`), and `characters` (unique/returning
  counts and a recent-activity roster).

## Notes

- Profession demand scores on the population survey are inferred from the
  observed class mix — never from observed sales. Item quantities are auction
  listings, not sales.
- A /who sample is currently-visible online players (server-capped, ~50 per
  scan), not a census. Character names identify characters, not people.
